cars.generation: Original SE5 / SE5A production-road sports-shooting-brake family
cars.variant: SE5 Ford V6 with optional Borg-Warner 35 — June 1970 UK test reference
cars.specification_market: Bill Boddy’s June 1970 first-hand UK test; July 2014 is the archive publication date. Retain the tested optional automatic, not an assumed standard gearbox. Steering stickiness/kickback, tailgate faults and restricted space temper the positive assessment. No OCR-corrupted tyre or steering-wheel dimension, later SE5A power, precise displacement or measured performance is imported.
cars.summary: The Scimitar GTE established a distinctive British sports-shooting-brake identity. Contemporary driving found sporting road behaviour and useful load space in its Ogle-styled four-seat body, making the original GTE a significant sporting design rather than an ordinary estate.

cars.generation: Original IR300 / IR340 production-road grand-tourer family
cars.variant: Rivolta GT 300 — Hellenic Motor Museum 1966 reference
cars.specification_market: The museum’s own 1966 collection-car record supplies 5359 cc, 300 bhp and 5000 rpm. Its power-rating standard is unspecified: no SAE/DIN equivalence or kW conversion is inferred. The manufacturer heritage separately supplies the original family’s chassis/body layout. Gearbox, torque, mass, speed and production total are not imported. One original GT family, not each output grade, is counted.
cars.summary: The original Rivolta GT established Iso’s performance grand-tourer lineage, combining Chevrolet V8 power with a dedicated platform chassis and Bertone four-seat body. That Italian-American engineering formula and foundational role in the marque’s sports-car history justify one original GT-family entry.

facts.explanation: The original Rivolta GT established Iso’s performance grand-tourer lineage, combining Chevrolet V8 power with a dedicated platform chassis and Bertone four-seat body. That Italian-American engineering formula and foundational role in the marque’s sports-car history justify one original GT-family entry.
